name: @goalloom/desktop
description: 把三个月的方向，连接到今天的行动。
author: Goalloom

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/build/third-party-notices.mjs && node scripts/build/check-production.mjs
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:production && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/build/package-report.mjs release latest darwin-arm64
scripts.package:win: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:production && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/build/package-report.mjs release latest win32-x64
scripts.package:mac:prepared: node scripts/build/prepared-build.mjs check && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never && node scripts/build/package-report.mjs release latest darwin-arm64
scripts.package:win:prepared: node scripts/build/prepared-build.mjs check && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/build/package-report.mjs release latest win32-x64
